0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Heat host the Timberwolves, and Miami is listing Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest), and Pelle Larsson (illness) as day-to-day, all game-time decisions. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and is also listing Bones Hyland, Enrique Freeman, Rocco Zikarsky, Rudy Gobert, and Trey Lyles as day-to-day. The Heat lost both meetings with Minnesota in 2025-26, including a 122-94 defeat in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance to win.
